payload.title: Record Map
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook is designed to reproduce a map figure from a research paper. It requires pre-existing pickle files containing data, which should be generated by running other notebooks in the 'Loading Data' folder. The notebook uses the Basemap library to create a map with shaded relief, coastlines, and latitude/longitude lines. It processes data by sorting it by latitude and visualizes it using matplotlib and seaborn.
goals: Reproduce the map figure from the paper

section_blurbs.blurb: The notebook reproduces a map figure from a paper, requiring pre-existing pickle files. It sorts data by latitude and uses Basemap to create a map with shaded relief, coastlines, and latitude/longitude lines.
section_blurbs.heading: Record Map

outputs: Map figure with shaded relief and geospatial data
